# seleniumbase-rs

> A Rust port of Python SeleniumBase 4.55.2 and its MCP server: a `BaseCase` test API over WebDriver, a pure Chrome DevTools Protocol engine with no driver, stealth and fingerprinting, a browser pool, request interception, and MCP servers that let AI agents drive, debug and write browser tests. Young (0.1.0, not on crates.io); most behaviour is verified against a mock or unit tests rather than a real browser.

Start here if you are an AI agent working in the repository or using the crate.

## Working on the repository

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/AGENTS.md): commands, rules, boundaries.
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): the module map and gotchas.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): the checks and how to add things.
- [docs/building.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/building.md): features, binaries, Docker.

## Using the crate

- [README.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/README.md): what it is and the project status.
- [docs/tutorials/getting_started.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/tutorials/getting_started.md): a first test.
- [docs/tutorials/reliable_tests.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/tutorials/reliable_tests.md): rules for browser tests that do not flake, in terms of this crate's API (also in AGENTS.md).
- [docs/tutorials/pure_cdp.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/tutorials/pure_cdp.md): the driver-free engine.
- [docs/tutorials/mcp_server.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/tutorials/mcp_server.md): the MCP servers and their tools.
- [docs/tutorials/vibe_coding.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/tutorials/vibe_coding.md): explore a page, export a test, read a failure.
- [docs/tutorials/stealth_scraping.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/tutorials/stealth_scraping.md): where the stealth scraping layer went: since 0.3.0 the former `scrape` and `impersonate` features (wire fingerprints, `BrowserScraper`, `HttpSession`, `MitmProxy`, `StealthSession`) are the experimental crates `seleniumbase-rs-codec`, `seleniumbase-rs-scrape` and `seleniumbase-rs-mimic` of https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs-stealth, and how to depend on them by git.
- [docs/tutorials/run_settings.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/tutorials/run_settings.md): `RunSettings`, the run-wide knobs Python takes from pytest options (demo, slow, fast, demo sleep, message duration, skip JS waits, record sleep, visual baseline reset), and which `BaseCase` calls honour each (the pauses reach `open`, `click`, `type_text`, `update_text` and `press_keys` only).
- [docs/reliability.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/reliability.md): waits, errors, cleanup.
- [docs/help/common_problems.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/help/common_problems.md): troubleshooting.

## Reference

- [docs/parity.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/parity.md): the status of every upstream API (generated from `parity/api.toml`).
- [docs/tutorials/api_reference.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/tutorials/api_reference.md): the `BaseCase` API.
- [docs/tutorials/fingerprint_stealth.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/tutorials/fingerprint_stealth.md): fingerprints and masking.
- [docs/comparison.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/comparison.md) and [docs/faq.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/faq.md): when to use it, and answers to common questions.

## Optional

- [docs/benchmarks.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/benchmarks.md) and [docs/performance.md](https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs/blob/main/docs/performance.md).
